overview_description.description:
Orbio helps energy companies reduce methane emissions. 

We do this by fusing satellite data with ground data to help environmental engineers and asset operators develop effective emission reduction strategies on the ground.

competitors_list.target_short_description: GHGSat’s mission is to become the global reference for remote sensing of greenhouse gas
Kuva Systems is an industrial IoT solutions company that provides emissions monitoring and quantification of methane and VOC.
SeekOps develops gas sensing technology and data solutions to provide end-to-end GHG emissions reporting to energy customers.
Qube is an information technology company that offers artificial intelligence, augmented reality, and physical security services.
Bridger Photonics is a LiDAR solutions provider, enabling new capabilities and improving efficiency for industrial sensor applications.
Carbon Mapper provides locating, quantifying, and tracking methane and CO2 point-source emissions services.
Project Canary is a B-Corp that reduces GHG emissions and impacts in the energy, waste, and agriculture sectors through sensor measurement.
Aeroqual is leading the move towards sensor-based air quality monitoring.
Watershed serves as an enterprise climate platform utilized by companies to assess, report, and address their carbon emissions.
Persefoni AI is an IT company that provides a climate management and accounting platform for real-time management and disclosure.
Satelytics is a big data SaaS that allows companies to monitor their assets on the ground and alerts them to critical issues.
